title: VARTA 2026 grass fiber and whole-grass nutrient laboratory measurements
geography: GreenHub and Reterra samples; exact collection sites are not fully specified by the workbook
evidence_class: A, laboratory values as reported in user-supplied workbook
persistent_identifier: VARTA_2026_10_27 (project-local dataset identifier; not a DOI)
license: No external reuse license identified; project-supplied laboratory data
translation: English headers and sample labels are accompanied by the original Dutch sample labels. Source row and worksheet are retained.
unit_note: The legacy column dry_matter_fraction contains percent points. The added dry_matter_percent column is an exact alias in percent and is the field used by the model loader; divide by 100 to obtain a mass fraction.
activation_state: partial calculation connection for the explicit grass_varta_default sample profile only; GreenHub whole-grass row 7 dry matter and chloride are used, while other samples and analytes remain references
readiness_state: partial D4 for row 7 dry matter and chloride: calculation-connected, covered by profile and service tests, and reported with row-level provenance; not representative of seasonal feedstock

connected_calculation.dry_matter: 0.143 kg dry matter/kg wet feed; used for profile moisture and dry-to-wet conversions
connected_calculation.chloride_ion: 11.7 g/kg dry matter × 0.143 ÷ 1000 = 0.0016731 kg chloride/kg wet feed; mapped to ChlorideIon and partitioned from the literature ash pool

missing_value_policy: Blank source values remain blank; values below detection limits remain censored text in the extract and are not zero-filled.
limitations: Only 18 fiber/whole-grass and 3 juice sample records are present; these are sample-specific and do not define a seasonal distribution or supply quantity.
The GreenHub whole-grass sample is dated 2026-07-16; it is not a representative annual mean.
No DOI or explicit redistribution license is identified in the source workbook.
The explicit profile still uses literature proxies and structural component closure for feed properties not measured in the workbook.
The workbook does not supply chloride extraction method, replicate uncertainty, full nutrient speciation, or ion charge balance.
